# Onyx Beach Hotel, Canggu, Bali

> Luxury hotel with 7 suites around a pool on Jalan Padang Linjong, Canggu, Bali. Nightly, weekly and monthly stays; book direct for the best price.

- Address: Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong No.45x, Canggu, Bali 80351, Indonesia
- WhatsApp (replies 24/7, prices and bookings): +62 821-7148-622, https://wa.me/628217148622
- Book online or send a booking request: https://onyx-whatsapp.onyxbeachhotel.workers.dev/book
- Check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00, minimum stay 2 nights

## Rooms (IDR)

- [Penthouse](https://onyxbeachhotel.com/rooms/401/): 2-bedroom penthouse, top floor, 183 m². From IDR 2.800.000 a night, IDR 17.500.000 a week, IDR 55.000.000 a month.
- [Grand Suite](https://onyxbeachhotel.com/rooms/201/): 1-bedroom apartment, 83 m². From IDR 1.400.000 a night, IDR 9.000.000 a week, IDR 34.000.000 a month.
- [Sunset Suite](https://onyxbeachhotel.com/rooms/203/): Suite with balcony and full kitchen, 54.5 m². From IDR 1.200.000 a night, IDR 7.500.000 a week, IDR 30.000.000 a month.
- [Deluxe Suite](https://onyxbeachhotel.com/rooms/202/): Suite with kitchenette, 35 m². From IDR 1.000.000 a night, IDR 6.500.000 a week, IDR 24.000.000 a month.
- [Deluxe Suite](https://onyxbeachhotel.com/rooms/302/): Suite with kitchenette, 35 m². From IDR 1.000.000 a night, IDR 6.500.000 a week, IDR 24.000.000 a month.
- [Standard Suite](https://onyxbeachhotel.com/rooms/101/): Ground-floor suite, 31 m². From IDR 950.000 a night, IDR 6.000.000 a week, IDR 20.000.000 a month.
- [Standard Suite](https://onyxbeachhotel.com/rooms/102/): Ground-floor suite, 31 m². From IDR 950.000 a night, IDR 6.000.000 a week, IDR 20.000.000 a month.

Peak season (December, July, August): monthly stays cost more. Returning guests booking direct get 10% off.

## Good to know

- What rooms do you have? Seven suites around a pool: Standard Suites (31 m², ground floor), Deluxe Suites (35 m², kitchenette), the Sunset Suite (54.5 m², kitchen and balcony), the Grand Suite (83 m², separate living room, full kitchen, balcony) and the two-bedroom Penthouse with a private rooftop jacuzzi.
- Is there a minimum stay? 2 nights. Weekly and monthly stays have their own lower prices.
- Do the rooms have air conditioning and hot water? Yes, every room has air conditioning and hot water.
- Can I cook? Every unit has a stove. The Deluxe Suites have a kitchenette; the Sunset Suite, Grand Suite and Penthouse have a full kitchen. Standard Suites have a mini fridge.
- How often is the room cleaned? Housekeeping comes every 2 days on every stay, nightly, weekly or monthly, and all linen is changed once a week.
- Is the Wi-Fi good for remote work? Yes, the Wi-Fi is fast and reliable, and every suite has space to work.
- Is there a lift? No, the building has stairs only. Tell us if you have heavy luggage or need a ground-floor room.
- Can you add a baby cot or an extra bed? Yes, ask us and the team will arrange it.
- What are check-in and check-out times? Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 11:00. Late check-out until 12:00 is 10% of the night, when the room is free.
- Can I check in early or leave my bags? Early check-in is free when your room is ready, and luggage storage is free.
- How far is the airport? Ngurah Rai Airport (DPS) is usually about an hour by car, often more in afternoon and evening traffic. We can arrange an airport pickup.
- How do I get in if I arrive late? Message us on WhatsApp on your arrival day: confirmed guests get their entry details there.
- Are pets allowed? No, we don't allow pets.
- Can I smoke? On your balcony and at the smoking tables by the pool, never inside the rooms.
- Can I have visitors? Yes, visitors are welcome. No parties, please.
- Is it safe? Yes: there is 24-hour security and CCTV.
- When is the pool open? Usual hotel hours, from the morning into the evening; please keep it quiet at night.
- How do I pay? By bank transfer, cash or online payment. There is no card machine at the desk.
- Is there a deposit? Weekly and monthly stays: a 30% deposit holds the room and the balance is paid on arrival. Monthly stays also have a refundable security deposit, as usual in Bali; we confirm the amount when you book.
- Is electricity included? Yes, electricity is included on monthly stays.
- Can I get an invoice? Yes, we provide invoices and receipts, for example for your company or visa.
- Is it cheaper to book direct? Yes. Booking direct costs less than Booking.com or Airbnb for the same room, and returning guests get 10% off.
- What is your cancellation policy? For direct bookings we confirm the terms when you book.
- Where is Onyx? On Jalan Padang Linjong in Canggu, a quiet street between Batu Bolong and Echo Beach (2.3 km), with cafés, restaurants, yoga and spas nearby.
- How far is the beach? About a 13-minute walk. A minimart is less than a minute away.
- Is there a restaurant? No restaurant on site, but there are food vendors close by, and GoFood and GrabFood deliver to the door.
- How do I get around? Most guests use a scooter or the Grab and Gojek apps. We can arrange scooters, drivers and tours.
- Is there construction nearby? No, there is no construction around Onyx. It's a quiet street.
